name: Apex Bio-Swarm
identity: An evolving chitin hive: endless gaunts, warrior-broods and bio-titans that re-evolve every round to counter the enemy.

rules.name: Synapse & Evolution
rules.description: Command Phase: choose 1 Bio-Adaptation for the whole army this round: Scythes (+1 PEN in melee) · Chitin (+1 ARM to the 3+ cap) · Adrenal (+2″ Move). Units within 9″ of a [SYNAPSE] model ignore Suppression.

rules.name: Gamble — Metabolic Overdrive
rules.description: When a unit activates: +2″ MOV and +1 Attack in melee this activation. At the End of Round, roll a D6: on 1–2 it suffers D3 Fatal Wounds (models die of exhaustion). (Risk: durability (dice).)

detachments.name: Invasion Swarm
detachments.playstyle: Endless gaunts: drown objectives in bodies, recycle them through Synapse.

rules.name: Hunger of the Hive
rules.description: Trooper units within 9″ of Synapse get +1 Attack in melee if they outnumber their target.

enhancements.name: Bio-Spawning Sac
enhancements.description: **Bio-Warrior Brood** only. Endless Swarm returns 2 Chitter-swarm models per round near this unit.

stratagems.name: Overrun
stratagems.turn: A Trooper unit destroys a unit

stratagems.name: Swarm Wave
stratagems.effect: Set up a new 10-model Chitter-Swarm at your board edge (once per battle).

stratagems.name: Chitin Wall
stratagems.effect: +1 ARM for that attack (stacks with the Chitin adaptation to the cap).

detachments.name: Synaptic Vanguard
detachments.playstyle: Ambush hunters: Shade-Stalkers and Tunnel-Wyrms strike leaders from hiding.

rules.name: Lurking Death
rules.description: [VANGUARD STRIKE] and [INFILTRATORS] units get +1 to Wound on the activation they arrive or first attack.

enhancements.name: Chameleonic Mutation
enhancements.description: **Shade-Stalker** only. Ranged attacks against the bearer get −1 to Hit.

enhancements.name: Pheromone Trail
enhancements.description: **Shade-Stalker** only. Vanguard Strike units may arrive within 6″ of the bearer (still >8″ from enemies).

stratagems.name: Vanish into Burrows
stratagems.effect: One unit not engaged returns to Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Bio-Titan Assault
detachments.playstyle: Monster mash: Tyrant, Carno-Brutes and a Bio-Horror walk through the enemy.

rules.name: Primal Evolution
rules.description: Class 3+ units benefit from the round's Bio-Adaptation twice over (Scythes +2 PEN · Chitin +1 ARM and −1 Damage · Adrenal +4″ Move).

stratagems.name: Rapid Regrowth
stratagems.effect: Ignore up to 3 MIGHT from that attack (mitigation, not healing).

stratagems.name: Bio-Acid Spray
stratagems.effect: Engaged enemies suffer D3 Fatal Wounds.
